description: NaGe₂P₃O₁₂ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.42 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a hexagonal planar geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.54 Å. There are two inequivalent Ge sites. In the first Ge site, Ge is bonded to six O atoms to form GeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.88 Å) and three longer (1.92 Å) Ge-O bond lengths. In the second Ge site, Ge is bonded to six O atoms to form GeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.87 Å) and three longer (1.91 Å) Ge-O bond lengths. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four GeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 29-40°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.55 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ge, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ge, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ge and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ge and one P atom.
